xna-type.name: FogMode
xna-type.summary: This enumeration is available only when developing for Windows.
xna-type.remarks: Fog can be considered a measure of visibility. The lower the fog value produced by a fog equation, the less visible an object is.

member.name: Exponent
member.summary: Fog effect intensifies in a linear manner between the start and end points, according to the following formula.

member.name: ExponentSquared
member.summary: Fog effect intensifies exponentially with the square of the distance, according to the following formula.

member.name: Linear
member.summary: Fog effect intensifies exponentially, according to the following formula.
